entities.summary: Rita Gertrudis Bosaho Gori is an Equatorial Guinean-Spanish politician and activist member of Podemos, who served as Director-General for Equality of Treatment and Ethnic-racial Diversity in the Spanish Ministry of Equality from 2020 to 2023. She was a member of the 11th and 12th terms of the Congress of Deputies. In 2015, Bosaho became the first person of color, male or female, to be elected to a seat in the Spanish Parliament.
